seo.title: About DevToolHive - Free Local Developer Tools
seo.description: About DevToolHive, free developer and game-dev tools running 100% in your browser.

body.intro: DevToolHive is a free online developer and game-dev tool hub. Every tool runs entirely in your browser — no data is uploaded to any server, no account is required, and it is free forever.
body.mission: Our mission is to provide fast, privacy-first developer utilities for a global audience, available in 7 languages.
body.local: All tools perform 100% local browser processing. Your inputs never leave your device.
body.revenue: We are funded solely by Google AdSense display ads. There are no paid features, no subscriptions, and no data sales.
